# Known differences between ICU4X 2.4 and the Unicode 18.0.0 break tests
#
# ICU4X 2.4's stable constructors segment Unicode 18.0.0 property data with
# rule tables written for earlier versions of UAX #29 and UAX #14: the stable
# line segmenter uses its `SegmenterBreakLineV1` (Unicode 15.1) rules, and the
# grapheme segmenter predates the Unicode 18.0 form of GB9c, which no longer
# needs a linking consonant before the conjunct linker. Each list names the
# line numbers, in the comment-stripped file beside this one, of the cases
# whose breaks differ; the harness (`src/frontend/conformance.rs`) asserts
# the exact set, so a fix or a new regression fails it.
#
# Regenerate after an ICU4X upgrade, never by hand.
